page.layout: One column of lexicon entries, Latin and Hebrew mixed; running head centred at top; page number top right; catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: phal נִעְבַּר Transfiri. Pihel עָבַר Gravidare, Gravidam efficere, Inire: item, Repagulo occlusit. Hiphil הֶעְבִּיר Transfire fecit, Transtulit, Transmisit, Traduxit. Hithpahel, הִתְעַבֵּר Excandescere, Furere.
עֶבֶר m. Transitus, Vadum, Latus ulterius: Cis, Ultra, Trans: Ex adverso, E regione: plur. עֲבָרִים.
עֵבֶר Heber, nomen proprium viri, ne potis Sem, Gen.10.24. Inde עִבְרִי Hebraeus, quasi Hebraeus: עִבְרִים Hebrai. Fœm. עִבְרִיָּה Hebraea: plur. עִבְרִיּוֹת Hebraeæ.
עָבָר m. Proventus, Annona, anni praeteriti: venturi, dicitur תְּבוּאָה à בּוֹא.
עֵבֶר f. Ponto, Navis, à Trajiciendo.
עֶבְרָה f. Excandescentia, Furor, Indignatio: plur. עֲבָרוֹת.
מַעְבָּרָה m. מַעֲבָרָה f. Vadum, Transitus: plur. מַעֲבָרוֹת.
עָבוֹ m. Contortum, Tortile, Densum, Densus funis: plur. עֲבֹתִים, & עֲבוֹתוֹת.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew words are uncertain at this scan resolution; they are transcribed as best read without [?] marks. The running head and the catchword are Hebrew letters. The left and right edges are partly shadowed. Long s is written as plain s (e.g. "Es.4"). No marginal notes are printed.
